collectible.title: Imperial Coat of Arms Pen
collectible.subtitle: A quality writing instrument recieved from Edelgard, this quill pen is adorned with a black feather and engraved with the symbol of the Adrestian Empire.
collectible.text:
My friend,

I wanted to thank you again for our match the other day. While I never imagined I would be the sort to enjoy strip poker it was surprising effective at dealing with my pent-up stress. Even Hubert, my retainer, has noticed that I look more at ease. I haven't told him the cause, although, knowing him, he's already heard it all from his intellegence network.

Before we parted ways I mentioned the possibility of setting up another match with you. To that end, I checked with the reception desk at the Inventory and they told me they will hold letters; something you doubtless discerned when you recieved this one from them. As such, I've taken the liberty of enclosing a gift for you, a quill pen engraved with the double-headed eagle of the Adrestian Empire. Although I'm certain you possess writing implements in your world, I wanted you to have it as a token of my thanks and as a reminder that if you ever wish for another match, or simply to converse over tea, you need only write, and I will do my best to make time for you.

Sincerely, Edelgard von Hresvelg
